notes.title: Free Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
[b]FREE DEMO OUT NOW![/b]

A demo version for Isle of the Conjured will be released today! It will cover the first part of the game up to the first boss. Check it out once it releases!

[b]MINOR UPDATE. Version 2.2.1[/b]

This update will allow it so that you can skip the introductory cut scene.

Thanks!

notes.title: Version 2.2 Now Live
notes.content:
Version 2.2 is now live.

This version will introduce a new game mechanic. 

As you hit and defeat enemies, and as you get hit you will fill up a rage meter. Once at least one square of the meter is full, you can activate it by pressing down the left stick on a controller or 'V' key on the keyboard. In this state you will be able to cause twice as much damage than normal. This will include damage caused by Magic. Completely fill the meter and then you will be able to unleash five attacks in a row in this state.

This update will also include:

-A new NPC that will give you hints on where to find emeralds
-Adjustments to most boss's HP
-Different colours for falling platforms. This will make them more distinguishable from moving platforms
-More bug fixes when climbing
-Adjustments to enemy spoils. Some enemies now drop items that can fill your Rage Points (RP)
-Other minor bug fixes and adjustments to level design


Thanks for playing

notes.title: Version 2.1 Now Live. Week long sale, %50 off coming June 15!
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE VERSION 2.1[/b]

This update includes

-Shortened Game Over sequence
-Added a dodging image to the player
-Added an option to toggle Vsync (Vsync may cause the game to run slowly on certain monitors)

The game will go on sale for %50 off, starting on June 15, 2020, and will last until June 22.

Enjoy, and thanks for playing.

notes.title: Version 2.0 Now Live
notes.content:
[b]MAJOR UPDATE[/b]
Version 2.0 is now live.

This latest version will add some new features.

[b]CHALLENGES[/b]
After completing the game and restarting your quest, a new character will show up to offer you some challenges. Complete all challenges for some brand new and powerful equipment. These challenges include Speed Circuits which will be races against the clock to the finish flag, Ruby Rushes in which you will have to collect all of the rubies within the time limit, Monster Mash in which you will have to defeat all of the enemies in the area, and last but not least, 3-Hit Wonder challenges where you must reach the finish without taking anymore than three hits.

[b]THE ETHEREAL REALM[/b]
A portal to the Ethereal will become available upon restarting your quest. This will be a challenging area with very powerful enemies that can defeat you in one hit, unless of course you are able to receive the treasured equipment from the challenges. The Ultima Buster and Flight Orb will be needed for this area as well. Complete this area to take on a powerful super boss, and claim yet another reward upon defeating it.

notes.title: Version 1.1 Now Live!
notes.content:
An update to version 1.1 is now available.

This will allow it so that if you are defeated by a boss you will now have the option to restart close to the boss. This will make it so that you will not have to go through the entire dungeon again if you choose not to. The only exceptions will be for bosses that are already close to a save point/rest area.

Thank you for playing and enjoy!
